description: What scripts/run-tests.mjs does not run from test/*.mjs (RR-46): *.test.mjs files always run in one node --test batch; every other test/*.mjs runs as a script unless it is listed here. A new test needs no entry; add a file only when it is a helper, fixture or a check that CI runs in its own step (the packed tests run as test:packed and test:packed:peers; installed-regression.mjs runs inside test:packed:peers and the registry consumer, with the Noto script packages beside the installed binary).
